items.title: Why there's a tiny hole in your plane window 🔍
items.description: That little hole isn't a flaw — it's what stops the window cracking under pressure. #aviation #planes #flying #avgeek #didyouknow

items.title: Why airlines really lose your luggage 🧳
items.description: It isn't careless handlers. Your bag is scanned at every handover, and a tight connection is all it takes. #aviation #planes #flying #avgeek #didyouknow

items.title: Why almost every plane is painted white ✈️
items.description: Not a style choice. White keeps the cabin cooler, resists UV fading and makes cracks obvious. #aviation #planes #flying #avgeek #didyouknow

items.title: The black box isn't black 🟠
items.description: It's bright orange, and that's the least surprising thing about it. #aviation #planes #flying #avgeek #didyouknow

items.title: Why you MUST open the window shade for landing
items.description: It isn't about the view. It's a ninety-second survival rule. #aviation #planes #flying #avgeek #didyouknow

items.title: Why you always board a plane from the left
items.description: It's not tradition — the right side belongs to the fuel truck. #aviation #planes #flying #avgeek #didyouknow

items.title: Why planes fly at 35,000 feet
items.description: Thin air means less drag, less fuel and a smoother ride. #aviation #planes #flying #avgeek #didyouknow

items.title: Why planes dump fuel before landing ⛽
items.description: A plane can take off far heavier than it can safely land. #aviation #planes #flying #avgeek #didyouknow

items.title: Why planes leave white trails in the sky ☁️
items.description: Those lines behind a jet aren't smoke. #aviation #planes #flying #avgeek #didyouknow

items.title: The air you breathe on a plane comes from the engines 😮
items.description: It's called bleed air — and it's cleaner than it sounds. #aviation #planes #flying #avgeek #didyouknow

items.title: Why cabin lights dim for landing
items.description: Your eyes need to already be adjusted if anything goes wrong. #aviation #planes #flying #avgeek #didyouknow
